mapper.select: SELECT bst.bookset_id booksetId,/**账套**/ i.layering_id layeringId,/**分层代码**/ fin.VDATE as vdate,/**起息日**/ fin.actMdate as actMdate,/**实际到期日**/ bst.STANDARD_CCY as standardCcy,/**本位币**/ todo.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate,/**账套日期**/ todo.BOOK_DATE as bookDate,/**入账日期**/ todo.HAPPEN_DATE as happenDate, /**发生日期**/ /**母金融产品代码**/ fin.profit_type as profitType, /**收益类型**/ /**add by leipeng 20181017 **/ bst.BOK_SPEC_MODE AS bokSpecMode , /**特殊核算模型*/ bst.ACCT_MODE acctmode, /**核算方式*/ i.bok_detail_id bokDetailId,/*账务明细代码 */ i.busi_id busiId,/*业务明细代码 */ i.busi_detail_type busiDetailType,/*业务明细类型*/ i.branch,/*分支序号*/ i.lev/*级别序号*/ FROM BOK_BOOKSET bst INNER JOIN BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo ON bst.bookset_id = todo.bookset_id /**AND bst.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = '01'**/ INNER JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO I ON I.BOOKSET_ID = BST.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN ( select fin.FINPROD_ID, fin.vdate, fin.actmdate actMdate, profit_type,fin.finprod_type finprodType,null from FIN_PRODUCT fin where fin.profit_type = #{profitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union select fin_trd.FINPROD_ID, fin_trd.vdate, fin_trd.mdate actMdate, capi_income_feature profit_type, fin_trd.finprod_type finprodType, fin_trd.branch from fin_trade_product fin_trd where fin_trd.capi_income_feature =#{profitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) fin ON bst.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID and i.busi_id = fin.FINPROD_ID and i.busi_detail_type = fin.finprodType /**AND fin.finprod_type = 'F16'**/ WHERE todo.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND todo.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND todo.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND todo.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND todo.TASK_ID = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND todo.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
